description: This source file defines the MoonshotChatConfig class, which extends OpenAIGPTConfig to adapt OpenAI's chat completion API to Moonshot AI's specific requirements. It includes methods for message transformation, parameter mapping, and request configuration tailored to Moonshot AI's API constraints.
